name: Spellsinger
body:
You can funnel magic back into your song or other performance.

Prerequisites: Piper, Cha 13, able to cast 1st level spells.

Benefit: As part of the action to make a Perform check, you can channel the power of a spell into your presentation to magically augment it. Expend a prepared spell or spend a spell slot. Your Perform check gains an enhancement bonus equal to the level of the spell or spell slot expended.
